description: Test script for setting and validating Ethernet WAN enable status using halethsw module, with test case logic and external library tdklib.

classes.name: TDKScriptingLibrary
classes.description: Wrapper class for TDK test scripts, providing methods for test case setup, execution, and cleanup.

methods.name: configureTestCase
methods.description: Configures the test case with target IP, port, and test name.

methods.name: getLoadModuleResult
methods.description: Checks if the required module is successfully loaded.

methods.name: setLoadModuleStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of module loading.

methods.name: createTestStep
methods.description: Creates a test step object for executing specific test functions.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Executes the test case and retrieves the result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Gets the result status of the test step.

methods.name: getResultDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed output from the test step.

methods.name: setResultStatus
methods.description: Sets the pass/fail status for the test step.

methods.name: unloadModule
methods.description: Unloads the tested module after test completion.
